lockedMove.speaker: William Lane Craig
lockedMove.proposition: God may be unable to guarantee an evil-free world containing comparable moral good because causing significantly free agents always to choose rightly would be logically impossible.

components.text: Answers that God cannot causally guarantee right choices while preserving significant creaturely freedom.
Offers a modal reason why an evil-free free world might not be feasible for God.

charity.alternative: God need not guarantee perfect conduct to actualize a world with substantially less moral evil.
